overview.title: Manning Early Access Program (advertisement)
overview.main_topic: Manning's advertisement for MEAP, its early-access program.

learning_objectives: Recognize that this page is publisher back matter, not book content

summary:
A Manning **advertisement** for "The Manning Early Access Program" (MEAP), which lets readers buy books while they are still being written. The page lists five points: *Start now* (all available chapters in PDF, ePub, Kindle and liveBook formats), *Regular updates* (new chapters released as they are written), *Finish faster* (MEAP buyers get final versions first; pre-ordered print books ship when printed), *Contribute to the process* (reader feedback improves the book) and *No risk* (full refund or exchange if a MEAP is cancelled). It ends with "Explore dozens of titles in MEAP at www.manning.com."

There is no deep-learning content on this page.

takeaways: Publisher advertisement for MEAP; not book content.
